title: theobroma cacao subsp. sativum
intro: Theobroma cacao subsp. sativum, commonly known as Criollo cacao, is a subspecies of the cacao plant, a tropical evergreen tree native to the Americas. The health benefits of Criollo cacao include improved cardiovascular health, reduced stress levels, and enhanced cognitive function due to its high antioxidant content. The therapeutic actions of Criollo cacao include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as potential benefits for mood regulation and weight management. The bioactive constituents of Criollo cacao include flavonoids, such as epicatechin and quercetin, as well as phenolic acids and methylxanthines, which contribute to its potential therapeutic properties.
